subject: Friday: cake in the hangar (also, I wrote things down)
body:
All,

Cake in the hangar Friday at 3. Marcus is buying, which I have in writing.

Before I go: the graph project is done. Forty-three years of whatever is in my head is in there now. The contracts, the suppliers, the plants, the people who actually decide things. Even the stuff I never wrote down anywhere, like the Lot 4471 thing. Especially the Lot 4471 thing.

Ask it whatever you would have asked me. It answers faster and it does not need the fishing trip I am about to take.

The graph knows what I know. Trust the graph.

Gary
